Results.ReviewText: My Weber grill is absolutely a giant step above many other grills. The heavy duty fire chest is very sturdy! The grill surfaces are ready to care for and provide an excellent grilling surface. The grilling surfaces are easy to care for by following the included instructions. The heat disbursement is well distributed with no particular hot spots. The cabinetry is attractive and well built. I like the tank volume scale to see at a glance, how much fuel you have!
Results.Title: Fantastic grill!

Results.ReviewText: GREAT grill for a reasonable price.  This is the second one I’ve had - only replaced the first one because I was moving with a moving company and I didn’t trust them to move it without damage.  Comes up to heat quickly and is easy to control the heat.  Very little flare up.
Results.Title: Webber E-310 grill

Results.ReviewText: So this grill is a replacement for an older one of more or less the same model. I like the knobs mounted on the front which gives me more functional surface area on both side tables instead of just the left side on the older model. I like that this one has a tank scale included which I hope will help me to know when the tank is nearing empty. I also like that the 3 heat zones are arranged left to right rather than front to back on the older grill. I think this makes it easier for me to customize the temperature on different parts of the grill when I am cooking different things at the same time.
Results.Title: Enjoying My New Spirit Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I just bought my first Weber. The assembly was straight forward with no problems. I am amazed at how this grill manages heat distribution. I cooked burgers for the first thing. Something I’ve done many many times before. But now I just leave them in the same position they started in. The ones in the front were done just as well as the ones in the back. Plus there was no flare ups. The flavorizer bars gave them just a hint of smoky flavor like from a charcoal grill. I will have to make my days of grilling many more now. Way to go Weber. You’ve got another lifetime customer here.
Results.Title: This grill is awesome

Results.ReviewText: My husband said this is the best grill he’s ever had. Always bought other brands that were cheap and didn’t perform. Glad we splurged and got a Weber. Even cooking no matter where you place the food. Heats up QUICK and ignites effortlessly. Love the enclosed cabinet for gas tank. This 3 burner is perfect size for family of 4 and extra room for entertaining.  It’s only few months old so we will see how it hold up in time, but after reviews and research I’m confident it will. Highly recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
